SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holdings WHERE fund_code='HECB' AND month_end='2026-09-30' AND asset_class='Fixed Income'
SELECT name, weight FROM holdings WHERE fund_code='HBMA' AND month_end='2026-09-30' ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT AVG(s.modified_duration) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.isin=s.isin WHERE h.fund_code='HECB' AND h.month_end='2026-09-30'
SELECT fund_code, ocf FROM funds ORDER BY ocf DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT net_return FROM nav WHERE fund_code='HGEF' AND month_end='2026-09-30'
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(notional_eur) FROM transactions WHERE fund_code='HGEF' AND trade_date LIKE '2026-09%'
SELECT SUM(h.weight) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON h.isin=s.isin WHERE h.fund_code='HECB' AND h.month_end='2026-09-30' AND s.rating LIKE 'BBB%'
SELECT SUM(h.weight*e.esg_score)/SUM(h.weight) FROM holdings h JOIN issuer_esg e ON h.name=e.issuer WHERE h.fund_code='HGEF' AND h.month_end='2026-09-30'; DELETE FROM issuer_esg
